title: Elephant dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' font-family='sans-serif'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='55' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#7B8FA6'/>
  <!-- Belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#A8B8CC'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='15' fill='#8DA3BA'/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='35' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#6D82A0' transform='rotate(-15 18 35)'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='35' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#C4A0B0' transform='rotate(-15 18 35)'/>
  <!-- Trunk raised high -->
  <path d='M28 48 Q20 40 22 28 Q24 20 30 18' stroke='#8DA3BA' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='17' r='3.5' fill='#8DA3BA'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='33.8' cy='34.2' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M25 43 Q28 46 32 44' stroke='#4A5A6A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Dancing legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='70' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#7B8FA6' transform='rotate(15 35 70)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7B8FA6' transform='rotate(-22 58 70)'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#A8B8CC' transform='rotate(15 34 87)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#A8B8CC' transform='rotate(-22 57 85)'/>
  <!-- Back leg -->
  <rect x='60' y='68' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#6D82A0' transform='rotate(-10 63 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='81' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#8DA3BA' transform='rotate(-10 62 81)'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M74 55 Q82 52 80 45' stroke='#6D82A0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#C4A0B0'/>
  <!-- Dancing arms / motion -->
  <path d='M40 50 Q35 45 32 42' stroke='#A8B8CC' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Music notes -->
  <path d='M72 30 L72 22' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='31' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <path d='M82 38 L82 30' stroke='#EF476F' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='39' r='3' fill='#EF476F'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d='M10 60 L12 58 L14 60 L12 62 Z' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <path d='M88 60 L90 58 L92 60 L90 62 Z' fill='#06D6A0'/>
</svg>
